subject: FY23 Operating Budget Request
overview: The School Committee reviewed the administration's proposed FY23 operating budget categories and ESSER grant allocations. The committee voted to submit a $72.4 million budget request to the municipal government and affirmed plans to maintain universal free school meals.

items.title: FY23 Operating Budget and ESSER Funding Presentation
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy presented the proposed FY23 operating budget framework, outlining $2.6 million in fixed cost increases, open collective bargaining negotiations, and a categorization of funding priorities across operating funds and ESSER grants.

items.title: FY23 Municipal Budget Request and Free School Meals Motion
items.summary: Approved a motion to submit a $72.4 million FY23 budget request covering categories A, B, and D to municipal government, with an additional directive to provide free school meals and request supplemental city funding if state-level meal funding is not enacted.

items.title: Discussion on Budget Timeline and Municipal Priorities
items.summary: The committee and administration discussed the upcoming municipal appropriation process, potential contingency plans if the appropriation falls short of the request, and differing views on whether the committee should consider broader municipal budget constraints when setting school priorities.
